title: Hold an asbestos removal licence
what: Hold a class A licence to remove friable asbestos, and a class A or B licence to remove more than 10 square metres of non-friable asbestos.

sources.title: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not carry out the removal of the following at a workplace unless the person, or the person on whose behalf the work is carried out, holds a class A asbestos removal licence— (a) friable asbestos;

sources.title: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not carry out the removal of the following at a workplace unless the person, or the person on whose behalf the work is carried out, holds a class B asbestos removal licence or a class A asbestos removal licence— (a) more than 10m 2 of non-friable asbestos or ACM;

triggers.note: When the business removes friable asbestos, or more than 10 square metres of non-friable asbestos.

reach.condition: if it removes asbestos (friable, or more than 10 square metres of non-friable)
reach.note: Any business that removes asbestos; mostly demolition, construction trades and specialist asbestos removalists.

sources.title: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not carry out the removal of the following at a workplace unless the person, or the person on whose behalf the work is carried out, holds a class A asbestos removal licence— (a) friable asbestos;

assessment.summary: Removing friable asbestos, or more than 10 square metres of non-friable asbestos, needs a class A or class B asbestos removal licence held by the business doing it.

marks.reason: A licence, with qualified supervisors and set procedures, is needed before a business can take on asbestos removal work.

assessment.confidence_note: Marked from the licence's design against the framework's guide; the health benefit is not counted by the framework.
